summary: Mayfair Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K on April 21, 2026, containing a Notice of Meeting and Record Date for its Annual and Special Meeting of Security Holders scheduled for June 25, 2026. The filing sets the record date for notice and voting as May 15, 2026, and indicates that proxy materials will be delivered under Notice and Access for both beneficial and registered holders. This is a routine administrative filing providing meeting logistics and voting details for an annual meeting. There is no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. The filing is a standard procedural disclosure with no event-driven special situation content.
